name: Impossible product worlds
outcome: Fly above a giant product to reveal a luxury pool in its lid, then return to a clean hero shot in a short surreal commercial.
summary: Build a three-shot commercial around one continuous drone flight above a giant product, revealing a luxury pool inside its fitted lid.
Review the source stills and generated clips, then assemble an eight-second reveal, four-second tabletop shot, and three-second hero.
caveats: The recipe page includes a rendered 15-second silent concept film. Product proportions vary between the generated shots.
The bundled workflow explores product stills. Follow the Storyboard guide on the recipe page to plan, animate, and edit the complete commercial.
